hooks.name: Pre-HyperExecute Validation
hooks.description: Policy-driven preflight check that runs ONLY when a command actually launches HyperExecute. Scoped to shell tools; no-ops for every other command so it never blocks ordinary reads/edits.

action.prompt:
A shell command is about to run. FIRST decide whether it actually launches a HyperExecute job.

Inspect the tool input command string:
- If it invokes the HyperExecute binary (contains 'hyperexecute.exe' or 'hyperexecute ' with a '--config' flag) → this IS a HyperExecute run. Proceed to validation below.
- Otherwise (any other command — ls, git, npm, tsc, playwright, file ops, etc.) → this is NOT a HyperExecute run. Do NOTHING and allow the command. Exit 0 immediately.

Validation (ONLY when it is a HyperExecute run):
1. Read .kiro/skills/execution-skill/assets/hyperexecute-policy.json
2. Execute each check listed in the preflightChecks[] array (spec files exist; test count > 0; no duplicate TC-IDs; all spec imports resolve to fixtures/ only — never @playwright/test or a lambdatest-setup module; LT_CDP_URL present in the YAML env block or the run would silently use a local browser; tunnel enabled; credentials loaded from .env; stale artifacts cleaned).
3. If ANY check fails → BLOCK execution (exit 2) and list which checks failed.
4. If ALL checks pass → allow the command.

Do NOT invent checks. Only apply what hyperexecute-policy.json specifies in preflightChecks[]. Never block a non-HyperExecute command.
